reports.title: Zoetis Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results; Highlights Progress Advancing Innovation Across Diversified Portfolio and Narrows Full Year 2026 Revenue Guidance, Raises Full Year 2026 Adjusted EPS Guidance

guidance.heading: FULL YEAR 2026 FINANCIAL GUIDANCE
section: •Narrowed revenue to a range of $9.220 billion to $9.320 billion (organic operational growth of (2)% to (1)%)
•Raised adjusted net income to a range of $2.600 billion to $2.640 billion (organic operational growth of (7)% to (5)%)
•Raised adjusted diluted EPS to a range of $6.25 to $6.35

This guidance reflects foreign exchange rates as of October 20, 2026. Additional details on guidance, including reconciliations of non-GAAP financial measures and the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures, are included in the financial tables and will be discussed on the company's conference call.
